summary: The speaker who never came: The person meant to speak for {candidate} at the gathering has not come, and the room looks for someone.
realLife: As a college student in 1930 he campaigned for Welly Hopkins, a state senate candidate, after a rousing speech at a political meeting in Blanco, Texas. Hopkins and Johnson's father then recommended him to a new congressman, who hired him. The speaker who fails to come is the game's addition.
gates: You back one of the candidates.
weights: Speaking traits, and a school record of debate or speeches.
choices: stand up and speak for {candidate} (a short speech, one part at a time)

branches.then: {candidate} finds you after and asks you to work on the campaign full time.
The parts you pick do not fit the room. {candidate} thanks you politely, and {host} remembers you tried.
{friend} volunteers you out loud. You can still decline, and {friend} brings it up later.
